contents.text: Do I need to lock out the motor before opening the seal housing?

Before opening any CP-200 seal housing, apply lockout/tagout (LOTO) to the motor and isolate the seal-water and process lines. Before opening any CP-200 seal housing, isolate the motor electrically and lock it out.

Safety bulletin SB-0932: Seal housing work
# Safety bulletin SB-0932: Seal housing work
Issued after a near miss at the Riverside plant in 2026, when a seal housing was opened on a pump that was still under seal-water pressure.
Apply lockout/tagout (LOTO) to the motor and isolate the seal-water and process lines before opening any CP-200 seal housing.
Zero energy means that the motor can't start from the panel, the local pressure gauges read zero and the casing drain is open.
Supervisors brief their teams on it before the next seal job and record the briefing.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 1 Safety
# 1 Safety
- Isolate the motor electrically and lock it out before any work on the pump.
- Release the pressure in the casing and the seal-water line before opening any connection.
- Wear safety glasses and gloves when handling the mechanical seal.
The seal faces are brittle and their edges are sharp.
